title: Understanding Anomie and Modern Society
text:
Anomie, a concept initially introduced by Émile Durkheim, refers to a state of normlessness within a society. It occurs when the established moral guidelines or social regulations fail to provide adequate guidance to individuals regarding their aspirations and behaviors.

During periods of rapid social change, such as economic boom or crisis, traditional structures can weaken faster than new ones solidify. This dislocation creates an environment where expectations are ambiguous, leading to feelings of disorientation among the populace. Consequently, adherence to shared values diminishes, impacting overall social cohesion.
